lead.body: The longest climate summit on record closes in Antalya without a pact, after the EU and others reject a text that never named fossil fuels. It is the first such failure since Copenhagen in 2009, and the UN chief says the science has 'no ambiguity'.
lead.headline: COP31 ENDS WITH NO DEAL
lead.label: CLIMATE

panels.body: After Iran's strike on a civilian facility, Bahrain takes its case to the United Nations, with Saudi Arabia in solidarity. A Houthi missile aimed at the kingdom is intercepted.
panels.headline: BAHRAIN DEMANDS UN ACTION
panels.label: MIDDLE EAST

panels.body: Rescuers search the ruins of a Cikande candy factory for about 50 workers still unaccounted for. Seven body bags have been recovered; some 300 people were on shift when the fire broke out.
panels.headline: 50 MISSING IN INDONESIA FACTORY FIRE
panels.label: DISASTER

panels.body: A Russian drone collapses part of a five-storey building in Dymer, north of Kyiv. Fourteen people are unaccounted for as rescuers dig through the rubble.
panels.headline: DRONE LEVELS KYIV APARTMENT BLOCK
panels.label: WAR

panels.body: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigns over an AI-assisted cheating scandal, days before the Suneung college entrance exam.
panels.headline: SOUTH KOREA MINISTER QUITS OVER AI CHEATING
panels.label: ASIA

panels.body: Balendra Shah's state visit to India closes with talks in New Delhi reviewing the two neighbours' ties.
panels.headline: NEPAL'S PM HOLDS TALKS WITH MODI
panels.label: DIPLOMACY
